registryAssessment: The official West Tripura district land-records service page places the Directorate of Land Records and Settlement headquarters in Agartala and links to the e-JAMI land-record system. A Tripura government notice says DLRS provides e-JAMI records, registration, and cadastral-map access; its June 2025 service interruption notice reported both official and citizen portals inaccessible. No anonymous vector layer or geometry schema was verified.
